title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. STAIRS, SQUATS, AND A BIT OF STEAM. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. MONDAY. MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, WAKE THE LEGS, AND GET SOME AIR IN THOSE DESK LUNGS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THE KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS DONE. LEGS HONEST. LUNGS AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT SLOW. HOLD A BEAT AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND HIP OPENER. NO RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SLOW UP. SQUEEZE. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE HIPS AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A LAZY TRAMPOLINE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A STURDY STAIR OR LOW STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON A RAIL OR WALL IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A NEWBORN GIRAFFE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET SHOULDER WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. SMOOTH AND HONEST.
exercises.speakStart: SQUATS. TWO SETS OF TEN. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. THIS IS YOUR LEG STRENGTH. DO NOT HALF-SQUAT LIKE YOU ARE SCARED OF THE CARPET.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEPS. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. CONTROL THE DROP. OFFICE AISLE OR OPEN FLOOR. NO RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. LONG STEPS. CHEST UP. CONTROL THE DROP. THIS IS YOUR LEG STRENGTH. DO NOT SHUFFLE LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR TEA.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES IN STEADY RHYTHM. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR LUNG WORK. STEADY, NOT CHAOS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. STEADY RHYTHM. THIS IS YOUR LUNG WORK. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED HADDOCK.
exercises.speakDone: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
